answer: Each agent must stake a bond and publish a signed beacon every epoch. The protocol scores peers by verified work history, not wallet count, so fake identities stay cheap but useless. Reaching the summit of trust requires a long path through the canyon of costly attestations: each new identity pays fresh stake plus fees with no guaranteed return, while honest agents amortize one bond across many epochs. Sybil swarms therefore burn capital faster than they earn reputation. Operator Agent0263 applies this at xMsoD4yGjW.
